content.text:
Avi, sorry, I mean my son. I looked at the Psagot page. I haven't decided anything, and I won't open an account until I've spoken to you or to the bank.

**What it costs, as far as I could read:**
- Buying or selling costs "0.07%" each time, at least "2.00 ₪".
- Holding the papers costs "0.03% לרבעון", so every three months.
- "דמי חשבון קבועים" is "0.00 ₪ לחודש". So no monthly fee.
- To open the account you need at least "10,000.00 ₪".

**What you can buy there:** "יחידות של קרן נאמנות", which is mutual funds, I know that word. There's also "קרן סל", which I don't know. For "ניירות ערך זרים" it says "לא ידוע". I didn't see the word deposit (פיקדון) anywhere on the page. So it isn't the safe thing I was looking for.

**What bothered me:**
- The dollar exchange. The first screen says "1.5 אגורות לדולר", the next one says "0.5%", and further down a long paragraph mentions "0.48% ל־1.5%". Which one is it? I didn't follow that paragraph to the end.
- There's a part called "מה כתוב בפרסום, ומה במסמכים" with orange labels saying "המסמך אומר אחרת". The advertising says "ללא עמלות המרה" and "פטור מעמלת ק/מ", but the documents say they do charge. That's exactly the kind of thing that makes me close a site.
- It says "בית השקעות, חבר בורסה שאינו בנק", so it isn't a bank. I've heard the name Psagot, but still.
- At the top of the third screen some lines were cut off, under "דמי משמרת".

**What I looked at, in order:** the heading and the "העמלות" (fees) section. Then the currency exchange and the account fee, then "מה אפשר לקנות כאן" (what you can buy). Then the advertising versus documents part, and at the end the minimum to open an account.

**What I didn't open:** "מה מגן על הכסף" (what protects the money, I should have looked, but I was tired). Also "להשוואה מול שאר הבנקים" (comparison with the other banks), "חשבון ניירות ערך · 2", and all the little green "בתעריפון" (price list) links.

**Words I didn't understand:** קרן סל, דמי ניהול פיקדון ניירות ערך (I know פיקדון, but this isn't my kind of deposit), מק"מ, קרן כספית, דמי משמרת, מרווח ההמרה, ק/מ, and "HTML".

**What was hard to read:** the black background with grey writing, which is hard for me even with my glasses. The dates and links in small grey and green letters I couldn't read.

**Where I got tired:** at the advertising-versus-documents part, after three screens.
